comments.author: PreyToLive
comments.body_html: Most likely you have another mod that is already changing these settings to easy and medium. I know for sure that KMCs Server Value Modifier has the option of changing these, so you might want to check their first. If not though you can try changing the aki files directly. In your sptarkov folder go to \Aki_Data\Server\configs\inraid and make sure the aiAmount is set to “AsOnline” and the aiDifficulty is set to “AsOnline”.
